The '''Semag system''' was where [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] continued his [[Zaarin insurrection|campaign]] to destroy or capture the traitorous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Semag is an anagram for the word "games". When combined with the system name from the next TIE Fighter campaign ("Yllotat"), the company name [[Totally Games]] can be rendered.
